title: Remastered graphics: riders receive the world shadows
summary: With Graphics set to Remastered, the player's and CPU racers' vehicles and riders now darken where the world casts shadow. Before, only the ground and scenery took the shadows.
details: The shadow map is the same one the terrain and scenery already use. The rider takes four samples of it.
Remote riders and ghosts are unchanged.
Other presets are unchanged: their new branch is turned off by a setting that stays at zero.
limitation: No capture yet shows a rider standing in shade, so the darkening on the rider itself has not been checked by eye.
verification: make web, tools/test_engine_remastered.mjs (WebGL2) passes, and make precheck passes. Native captures of ENV01 and ENV05 under Original, Enhanced and High are identical to the build before the change.
